input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: 11.1 applies "[u]pon expiry or termination for any reason" and gives up to six months' transition assistance (priced at the expiring Order Form rates, which is at least as protective as then-current rates); 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format and bars withholding for a fee dispute; and 11.3 requires secure deletion and written officer certification only after Customer confirms successful return, so certified deletion follows data return. The only nuance is that the thirty-day return clock in 11.2 runs from Customer's request rather than from termination itself, which is not a material shortfall because no deadline is imposed on when Customer may request and Section 11 expressly operates on expiry or termination. No redline needed.
